example_line: org prompt "... The chart on the knee is kept in folder 0. ... The chart on the ear is kept in folder 5. ... The chart on the eye is kept in folder 3. ... The chart on the tongue is kept in folder 9. ... In which folder is the chart on the body part that tastes food?" -> answer org 9; the alt prompt asks about the eye (bridge alt), its 2nd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 3 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 5 (answer at the same statement slot), 0 (answer at the same token position), 7 (the alt prompt's own answer), 9 (answer org kept).
